name: ProcTHOR
summary: 用于具身智能训练与评测的程序化交互环境框架，可生成任意规模、多样且可定制的虚拟室内场景，官方样本包含 1 万套房屋。
summaryEn: A procedural framework for generating arbitrarily large, diverse, customizable interactive environments for embodied-agent training and evaluation, with an official 10,000-house sample.
scale: 10,000 generated houses in the official ProcTHOR-10K sample
scaleZh: 官方 ProcTHOR-10K 样本包含 1 万套生成房屋
license: Code is Apache-2.0; generated assets may have additional terms
licenseZh: 代码采用 Apache-2.0；生成资源可能适用附加条款
access: Official generator and ProcTHOR-10K sample available
accessZh: 提供官方生成器和 ProcTHOR-10K 样本
verdict: 大规模程序化交互房屋
wmNote: 可控场景生成适合扩大导航、重排和操作训练分布，但程序化室内环境与真实世界仍存在域差距。
wmNoteEn: Controllable scene generation expands navigation, rearrangement, and manipulation training distributions, with a domain gap from real homes.

evidence.sourceTitle: [2206.06994] ProcTHOR: Large-Scale Embodied AI Using Procedural Generation
evidence.statement: Procedural generation yields interactive environments for navigation, rearrangement and manipulation, with an identified simulator data path.
